native_finding: The deployed FilteredDiffusionController builds one latent feature from a five-step observation/action history, evaluates the critic on the raw action plus 25 evenly spaced actions, computes dec=qvals/qvals.max(), and accepts actions with dec>cbf_gamma. It does not compute an HJ Lie derivative or a CBF-QP in this path. The world model has separate margin_nogp/margin_gp/cont heads, but the shown deployment filter uses critic_old Q values. Therefore the proposed latent-metric contraction mechanism is not the native decision path; a corrected candidate would concern batch-relative Q normalization and candidate-set dependence, likely ordinary value-estimation/sampling sensitivity.
decision: Do not launch the proposed pilot until a corrected mechanism passes strict novelty review.
